fusions.name: Bolting Lunge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to the target and strike it for 14 damage, up to 1.3 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Thread Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a spool that deals 4 damage. Your movement speed rises by 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tether Hop
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. You gain +15% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Quick Hem
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 15%.
